lead.event: CGS downgrades BBYB and cuts its target price
lead.headline: CGS downgrades BBYB to hold and cuts target price to Rp 162 from Rp 350
lead.blurb: CGS now values the shares at 0.4 times 2027 price-to-book after cutting its 2026-2028 EPS forecasts by 5.7%-18.2% and lowering assumed return on equity to 12.5% from 15%. Bank Neo Commerce earned Rp431 billion in January-September, down 7% year on year, while loans fell 11% to Rp6.7 trillion. Management lowered its 2026 loan target to Rp7 trillion from Rp8 trillion.

deals_control.event: CNI plans to acquire 6.685 billion INET shares
deals_control.headline: CNI plans to buy 6.685 billion INET shares
deals_control.blurb: CNI, a subsidiary of Era Media Sejahtera, plans to buy the shares from Abadi Kreasi Unggul Nusantara at Rp300 each, after approval at Era Media Sejahtera’s 9 November RUPSLB. Abadi Kreasi Unggul Nusantara will remain INET’s controller.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: Harum Energy ends its share buyback program early
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: HRUM ends Rp120 billion share buyback early
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Harum Energy ended the program effective 17 November, citing capital-market rules and a restructuring plan being prepared by its controlling shareholders. Announced on 25 September, the buyback was set to cover up to 111 million shares, about 0.82% of issued and paid-up capital, through 24 December. The board said another buyback may be conducted under applicable rules.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: GMF Asia plans a rights issue of up to 22.02 billion shares
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: GMFI plans rights issue of up to 22.02 billion shares
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: The shares have a nominal value of Rp19 each, and existing investors who skip the offering face dilution of up to 15%. Proceeds are intended for expansion, capability development, equipment renewal, new subsidiaries and asset purchases, pending shareholder approval on 8 December.

market_structure_policy.event: ERAA joins the IDX LQ45 index
market_structure_policy.headline: ERAA joins LQ45 with a 0.25% index weight
market_structure_policy.blurb: Erajaya's inclusion runs from 18 November to 29 January 2027. Panin Sekuritas analyst Elandry Pratama sees it as a positive catalyst for visibility and institutional exposure, and sets a 12-month target of Rp600–Rp650 with a speculative buy on weakness recommendation.
